item.text:
Created the Rust port as a complete Cargo project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), with the root entry file at [test2.rs](/output/test2.rs) and shared logic in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs), [src/geometry.rs](/output/src/geometry.rs), and [src/triangulation.rs](/output/src/triangulation.rs). It uses only `std`, parses arguments from `std::env::args()`, preserves C-style `atoi` behavior for malformed and overflowed inputs, and emits byte-for-byte identical stdout including trailing spaces and no newline.

I compiled it successfully with `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition=2021 /output/test2.rs -o /output/test2`. I also compared `/output/test2` against `/workspace/dataset/test2_executable` across representative cases including no arg, `0`, `1`, `2`, negatives, whitespace-prefixed inputs, malformed strings, and overflow-style values; the outputs matched exactly.
